name: 3 fonts: Splinter, Dogshit, Iskele
short_description:
There are 3 different fonts in this collection. Splinter is sharp-edged, Dogshit is soft, and Iskele is in between.

Splinter font is inspired by the sharpness in nature. The structure of the font is thick and pointy. The most repetitive feature in the font is the parts resembling a knife-like shape.

Dogshit font is obviously inspired by the dog poop. It’s definitely organic so feel free to use it in your designs.

Iskele font is inspired by scaffoldings – also a street name in Turkey – The structure of the font is a bit calligraphic-like and wavy.

Font Bundle Content:

Splinter.ttf (82 glyphs)
Pier-Regular.otf (76 glyphs)
Scaffolding-bold.otf (76 glyphs)

name: Design Elements Pack #8: Y2K Shapes - 100 Pieces
short_description:
Y2K was a term used to describe the design of computer systems and software to ensure that they would be able to handle the transition from the year 1999 to the year 2000. This was important because many computer systems at the time used two-digit codes to represent the year, which meant that they would be unable to distinguish between the years 1900 and 2000. As a result, there was a concern that these systems might malfunction or fail entirely when the date rolled over from December 31, 1999 to January 1, 2000. 

To address this issue, designers had to go back and update their systems to use four-digit codes for the year, which would allow them to properly handle the transition to the new millennium. In addition to this, many systems also had to be tested to ensure that they would continue to function properly after the year 2000. Overall, the Y2K efforts were successful in preventing widespread disruptions and failures of computer systems during the transition to the year 2000.

We created Y2K shapes pack to bring back all the memories from that time and their aesthetic with it! We curates 100 unique shapes from that era and everything in vector form and ready to use!

Drop us an email if you need customized creatives for your project or company. 

Prepared for Dirtybarn by Beren Tezcanlı aka @berentezcanli__s

short_description:

Music, creativity, arts, networking, or tech—every interest and culture finds a proper place to thrive in the summer. It’s a young, fresh, and energetic season, making it the perfect time to come together.   • Call to Action and Ad Copy: Drive engagement and boost ticket sales with a persuasive call-to-action template. Craft compelling ad copy, urge your audience to take action, and maximize the impact of your promotional efforts.

name: 3D Lighter Mockup - 5 Scenes
short_description:
When we don’t need a lighter, there seems to be an abundance. But when we really need one, it’s like finding a needle in a haystack. So, we created a 3D mockup to always have one on hand.

It comes with 5 scenes and offers full color and design customization.

To Edit the 3D Lighter Mockup:

  1. Double-click the layer titled “Double Click.”
  2. To change the color on the mockup, use “Change Color.”
  3. A new tab will open in your software.
  4. Drag and drop your image into the new tab and press save.
  5. The main image will be updated accordingly.

You can also directly edit the mockup by dragging and dropping your desired image.

Asset Specs:

  • Fully customizable with Adobe Photoshop
  • 3240x4050px
  • 72dpi
  • 5 PSD files and scenes

name: Vienna Local Recommendations Map
short_description:
Piknik Works is a multidisciplinary design studio based between Istanbul and Vienna, operating at the intersection of architecture, art, and graphic design. Founded in 2017, the studio reimagines spatial experience through playful interventions, architecture & interior design, performative drawings, and visual storytelling. Whether designing spaces, exhibitions, public spaces or identities, Piknik approaches every project as a collective, open-air act of imagination.

www.piknik.works

https://www.instagram.com/piknik.works/

Now Piknik presents a new way to explore Vienna with The Local Recommendations Map of Vienna, 2025.

This map is an alternative city guide that moves away from tourist traps and predictable attractions. It highlights local cafés, bookstores, parks, and hidden corners that reflect the everyday rhythm of the city. The map is created for newcomers, tourists & travelers, and curious locals who want to experience Vienna’s authentic atmosphere and subtle charm.

The project was first released as a limited edition printed map, which is still available at Hafi Books in Vienna. It is now available online and downloadable via Dirtybarn for everyone who wishes to discover the city through a more personal and creative lens.

Whether you have just arrived in Vienna or have lived here for years, this map invites you to go beyond the obvious and explore the city through Piknik’s perspective, one street, one café, one story at a time.
